# Ridge with degree-hour features: validation and test (generated by `scripts/run_ridge_cddh.py`)

Git commit `267155d265`. ridge_full_rel with and without cooling/heating degree-hours (base temperature chosen on the training period), their 24 h means and an apparent-temperature index. MAE in MW; differences are with-minus-without (negative = the extra features help), 95% block bootstrap.

## Horizon 1 h

Base temperature chosen on the training period: 26 C (training MAE by base in the ratio target: 18: 0.00584, 20: 0.00584, 22: 0.00584, 24: 0.00583, 26: 0.00583, 28: 0.00584). Penalty: reference 10, with degree-hours 1.

| | validation MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge_full_rel (reference) | 1,094 |
| + degree-hours and apparent temperature | 1,094 |
| difference (95% CI) | +0 (-3 to +2) |

Test period (single run):

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| ridge_full_rel (reference) | 1,052 |
| + degree-hours and apparent temperature | 1,052 |
| difference (95% CI) | -1 (-3 to +1) |
| for context: selected ridge of the frozen run | 1,049 |
| for context: XGBoost S4 | 1,111 |
